_status: Module 3, Lesson 3.1 'At your desk, in the server room' (learner guide of 21 October 2026), word for word. Every control has two sides: what you do at your desk, and what IT sets up in the server room.
prompt: Whose side is it on? **You need to understand both, even if you only do the first.**

items.text: Use the VPN for office systems when away, and never share your VPN account
Default-deny rules, reviewed on a schedule, with logs watched
items.why: What IT sets up; ask for it, and know it is there.

items.text: Report security alerts and odd behaviour on your computer
Zones that keep guests, devices and staff apart from the servers
items.why: What IT sets up; ask for it, and know it is there.

items.text: Never plug unknown devices into the office network
MFA on VPN and admin accounts; no remote desktop open to the internet
items.why: What IT sets up; ask for it, and know it is there.
